meta.title: How Frankencoin works
meta.description: How ZCHF is minted against collateral, how the peg holds, how savers are paid and how FCS holders govern.

hero.title: Three moving parts, no issuer.
hero.subtitle: Frankencoin is a set of smart contracts. Borrowers mint francs against collateral, the market keeps the peg, and the income pays savers and shareholders.
